subject: DPIA: MedicaServe privacy impact assessment — template & evidence
messages:
From: Luis Fernandez <luis.fernandez@medicaserve.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: DPO MedicaServe <dpo@medicaserve.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 12:12:00 -0500
Subject: DPIA template — quick help requested

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our procurement for handling regulated patient metadata, our privacy team has a DPIA they require vendors to complete before we proceed. I attached our DPIA template (MedicaServe_DPIA_Template_2026.docx).

Could Redwood complete the sections related to data flows, data retention, subprocessors, and technical controls, or point us to the exact docs/evidence we can attach? Our DPO would like a short turnaround (by Friday if possible).

Key concerns: where patient-identifiable data might be cached, ability to support data subject ER requests / deletion, and what logs/audit evidence you can provide to demonstrate access controls.

Let me know if you prefer a quick call to walk through the doc.

Best,
Luis
Head of Integrations — MedicaServe

Attachment: MedicaServe_DPIA_Template_2026.docx (DOCX, 98 KB)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: DPIA template — quick help requested

Hi Luis — thanks for sending this over and for outlining the key concerns. I’ve looped in Rishi (sales/security lead) who will coordinate evidence, and our privacy lead (Vivek) for any legal/retention language we should include.

We can:
- Fill the DPIA template with our canonical responses for data flows and subprocessors
- Attach our SOC 2 summary and SOC 2 controls mapping for the sections about audit and access controls
- Provide a short memo on how we handle cache/KV retention and support subject requests (delete/port) in hosted and private deployments

We can aim to send a first-pass completed DPIA and supporting attachments by Friday EOD PT. If your DPO prefers, we can schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow to review the filled answers. Do you have availability 10:00–11:00 PT or 14:00–15:00 PT?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Date: Wed, 04 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPIA template — internal: MedicaServe request

Team — quick plan to produce the deliverables Luis requested. Summary / action items: 

1) Marissa: Confirm final DPIA responses with Luis and send completed template + attachments.
2) Rishi (me): Pull SOC 2 summary and the controls mapping; attach redwood_soc2_summary.pdf.
3) Vivek: Draft the privacy note on caching/KV retention and the subject-request handling (hosted vs private). We need plain-language statements plus the specific retention defaults and configurable knobs.
4) Lauren: Double-check subprocessors list and provide the canonical list plus any SOC/ISO evidence links for cloud partners.

Questions for legal/privacy: are we comfortable committing to the deletion timeline in section 4.3 (customer-initiated deletion within 30 days) for hosted customers, and how does that change for private deployments? I can propose a neutral phrasing if needed.

I’ll assemble everything into Redwood_DPIA_Response_v1.docx and circulate for sign-off before sending back to the customer.

Thanks — aiming to have draft by Thu EOD PT so Marissa can review and send on Fri.

-rishi
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Luis Fernandez <luis.fernandez@medicaserve.com>, DPO MedicaServe <dpo@medicaserve.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Feb 2026 16:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Completed DPIA responses + evidence — Redwood / MedicaServe

Hi Luis / DPO team,

Thanks for the patience — attached is our completed DPIA response (Redwood_DPIA_Response_v1.docx) plus a short evidence bundle: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf and a subprocessors list with links. Highlights: 

- Data flows & retention: We called out that PII is only retained in KV cache for a maximum of 2 hours by default for hosted API requests; customers can opt into longer retention when pinning models or enabling long-term sessions in Dedicated. For Private deployments all data remains in-customer VPC and retention is per-customer config.
- Subject requests: We support export and deletion APIs. For hosted customers: deletion requests processed within 30 calendar days after verification; for Dedicated we commit to assisting with deletion tooling and providing DB-level export scripts.
- Logs & audit: We included our SOC 2 controls mapping and a sample audit log extract format. Production audit logs are retained 90 days by default; longer retention available as an add-on.
- Subprocessors: listed cloud infra partners and telemetry vendors with links to their compliance pages.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether you want a short call to walk through any of the responses. If the DPO has redline language requests, we’ll coordinate legal.

Attachments: Redwood_DPIA_Response_v1.docx (DOCX, 64 KB), redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (PDF, 220 KB), subprocessors_list.csv (CSV, 4 KB)

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Office: +1 415-555-0110
